records.text: The 2025 Arizona Commanders Summit began at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base on September 9 and brought Arizona community leaders together with military commanders.

appearances.snippet: They happen to travel here for their annual commander summit on September 9th. That happened. You can see this pulling this up on the Davis-Monthan Air Force Base website.
